definition: "Actual" designates the physical commodity itself, used to distinguish it from financial contracts referencing that commodity.
core_idea: Since most energy trading happens in forward/financial form, traders need a specific word to flag that a deal involves the real physical commodity rather than a paper contract.
key_points: Used to differentiate physical delivery from financial contracts on the same commodity.
Example usage given: barrels of oil sitting on a tanker, described as "actuals."
